name: TunedGift
summary: Turns a story into a personalized song gift, with a one-song purchase, a monthly plan or a yearly unlimited plan.
description: TunedGift creates personalized AI songs as gifts, with AI covers, a private gift link and MP3 downloads.

pricing.details: Single Song 31 € one-time (second song +26 €; wall art sold separately); Pro Monthly 42 €/month (3 songs, 2 wall art and 2 videos per month); Platinum Yearly 196 €/year (unlimited songs, 10 wall art and 10 videos per month, priority support).
pricing.label: Premium

features: Personalized AI songs as gifts, with a private gift link and MP3 downloads
One-song purchase or monthly / yearly plans
Optional wall art and videos on the paid plans
